title: Finiteness of integral representations on 2-perfect truncation polytopes
summary: Let $P$ be a compact hyperbolic Coxeter truncation polytope of dimension $d\ge 3$, and let $Γ$ be the orbifold fundamental group of the associated Coxeter orbifold $\mathcal{O}_P$. Let $\mathscr{G}(Γ,G)$ be the geometric component containing the holonomy representation in $\operatorname{Hom}(Γ,G)/G$. $\mathscr{G}(Γ,G)$ is identified with the deformation space of properly convex real projective structures on the Coxeter orbifold $\mathcal{O}_P$.
